question: What adult posterior-hypothalamic molecular regulatory state connects rs1421085 T>C to increased Irx3 expression, particularly in males?

upstream.claim: Engineered rs1421085 risk-allele mice show genotype-dependent Irx3 increase with a notable dose-dependent effect in male posterior hypothalamus.

downstream.claim: Increasing IRX3 in IRX3-positive posterior-hypothalamic neurons decreases neuronal excitability/activity and increases feeding/body weight; inhibiting those neurons phenocopies the behavioral direction.

missing_edge.to: Irx3 transcription increase in adult male posterior hypothalamus
missing_edge.missing: allele-dependent molecular mediator and native cell of regulatory action

hypotheses.name: ARID5B reuse
support: Exact rs1421085 ARID5B mechanism is causal in adipocyte progenitors.
CAUSAL-DNA GSE146692 screen detects Arid5b in 28.420% of Irx3-positive VPH cells.
Strict human-to-mouse motif portability preserves the same ARID5B allele-effect direction, strand and motif offset at the exact ortholog.
ARID5B RNA is detected in both sparse exact-locus-positive/Irx3-positive nuclei in the independent GSE226277 Multiome reanalysis.
against: DEL82 perturbation produced no detectable Irx3/Irx5 change in bulk young/adult hypothalamus.
No adult-PH exact-allele ARID5B occupancy measurement has been identified in reviewed primary studies or the targeted public-data search.
hypotheses.next_test: Measure ARID5B occupancy at the intact rs1421085 element in T/T vs C/C adult PH cells, sex-stratified.

hypotheses.name: CUX1 exact-site/combinatorial role
support: Published exact-site assays show allele-dependent CUX1 P110/P200 binding preference.
CAUSAL-DNA GSE146692 screen detects Cux1 in 35.288% of Irx3-positive cells and 54.420% of Irx3/Arid5b double-positive cells.
Strict human-to-mouse motif portability preserves the same CUX1 allele-effect direction, strand and motif offset at the exact ortholog.
CUX1 RNA is detected in both sparse exact-locus-positive/Irx3-positive nuclei in the independent GSE226277 Multiome reanalysis.
against: Existing neuronal CUX1 model linked the locus to FTO/RPGRIP1L/AKTIP rather than genotype-associated IRX3/IRX5.
No direct adult-hypothalamus CUX1 occupancy measurement at the exact ortholog was identified in the targeted public-data search.
hypotheses.next_test: Measure CUX1 occupancy/state at the exact element in adult PH and perturb CUX1 while preserving the SNP-containing sequence.

hypotheses.name: Allele-dependent chromatin accessibility
support: Deletion-versus-point-substitution discordance is compatible with an intact-element state change.
The exact 500-bp tile containing the mouse ortholog has low-frequency raw accessibility across the intended 8/8 adult male hypothalamus snATAC samples in GSE246791.
The all-8 official-subclass analysis contains 154 exact-tile-positive nuclei among 83,321 nuclei and statistically prioritizes LHA-AHN-PVH Otp Trh Glut cells.
against: The exact locus is absent from the thresholded union candidate-enhancer catalog, arguing against a strong constitutive adult-brain cCRE.
All available accessibility evidence is wild-type; no T-vs-C adult-PH accessibility contrast is yet available.
hypotheses.next_test: Matched T/T vs C/C snATAC or targeted ATAC in the statistically prioritized adult PH/LHA/AHN/PVH cell states, male and female.

hypotheses.name: Allele-dependent 3D enhancer-target contact
support: FTO obesity interval has published long-range IRX3/IRX5 interactions in brain/hypothalamic-neuron contexts.

Reanalysis of the published adult-hypothalamus GSE295850 H3K27ac+ PLAC-seq significant-call set identifies one 10-kb contact between the bin containing the exact rs1421085 ortholog and the Irx3 promoter bin: observed count 49, expected 12.6272643735288, FDR 2.8483024481983e-14.
against: The secondary interaction-model table does not reproduce the primary call's exact count/expected/FDR tuple.
A separate Fed/Fasted 5-kb comparison contains the coordinate pair but does not show a significant state-dependent difference (FDR 1.0).
The 10-kb call cannot show that the exact 500-bp element or exact base is the physical contact anchor, nor that contact differs between T and C alleles.
hypotheses.next_test: Measure exact-element-to-Irx3 contact in matched T/T vs C/C adult PH genotype/sex/cell-state groups and resolve the 10-kb anchor to the exact regulatory element.

hypotheses.name: Indirect mediator
hypotheses.next_test: Raise priority only if local occupancy/accessibility/contact measurements fail to mediate the genotype-to-Irx3 effect.

hypotheses.name: Cell composition rather than per-cell transcription
support: Regional expression measurements cannot alone distinguish per-cell induction from composition/state shifts.
Exact-tile accessibility is non-uniform across official adult hypothalamus subclasses, so cell-state composition remains relevant.
against: Independent same-nucleus GSE226277 data show exact-locus ATAC plus Irx3 RNA in the same nucleus in 2/4 biological pairs, demonstrating at least sparse per-nucleus compatibility.
hypotheses.next_test: Exact-SNP single-cell or spatial expression with cell abundance and per-cell Irx3 modeled separately in genotype- and sex-matched tissue.

hypotheses.name: Sex/context interaction
support: Male posterior hypothalamus shows a notable genotype-dose Irx3 response that was not observed in females.
against: Coarse Arid5b/Irx3 and Cux1/Irx3 transcript co-detection is similar between pooled male and female GSE146692 cells.
The seven-candidate Irx3-positive transcript feasibility screen shows only small and inconsistent male-female differences, arguing against simple TF transcript availability as the sex mechanism.
hypotheses.next_test: Test allele-by-sex interaction at accessibility, methylation, occupancy and contact layers, not only baseline transcript abundance.

hypotheses.name: Point-substitution-specific intact enhancer grammar
support: Exact T>C and 82-bp deletion yield discordant adult CNS observations.
rs1421085 has evidence for multiple allele-sensitive factor grammars.

The exact ortholog lies outside the previously functionally deleted Fto-Irx::hibE1 element by about 13.9 kb after assembly reconciliation, so published hibE1 deletion phenotypes do not perturb this exact sequence.
hypotheses.next_test: Preserve the element and compare exact alleles while measuring occupancy, accessibility, methylation, contact and Irx3 in the same biological context.

hypotheses.name: Temporal/developmental gating
support: Larger FTO obesity-interval deletion affects Irx3/Irx5 in embryonic/developmental hypothalamic contexts but not adult bulk hypothalamus.
Human hypothalamic precursor deletion effect is restricted to a POMC-expressing subgroup.
hypotheses.next_test: Include developmental/state markers in adult responding cells and compare with developmental locus states.

hypotheses.name: Multi-target enhancer grammar
support: Different cellular contexts link the FTO interval to IRX3/IRX5 versus FTO/RPGRIP1L target programs.
hypotheses.next_test: Measure Irx3, Irx5, Fto and Rpgrip1l together with contact/occupancy in the exact adult PH allele contrast.

hypotheses.name: Methylation-sensitive local regulatory state
support: Adult male hypothalamus WGBS GSE84533 shows a highly methylated CG substrate within +/-250 bp of the exact ortholog in all 3/3 biological replicates: coverage-weighted mCG 95.918%, 97.222% and 93.103%.
The nearest qualifying CG is 1 bp upstream of the ortholog in all three replicates and is 100%, 83.33% and 83.33% methylated respectively.
Strict human-to-mouse motif analysis and adult Irx3-positive transcript screens retain multiple methylation/chromatin-linked candidates including MECP2, TET1, KDM2B and DNMT1.
against: The WGBS data are bulk wild-type adult male hypothalamus and cannot establish cell-specific or allele-dependent methylation.
A methylated local substrate does not identify its functional reader or prove that methylation mediates the T>C effect.
Direct adult-hypothalamus MeCP2 ChIP/Input exact-locus analysis remains unresolved at this status update.
hypotheses.next_test: Finish direct MeCP2 ChIP/Input exact-locus context, then compare methylation and top reader occupancy between exact T and C alleles in the prioritized adult PH neuronal state.

demoted_candidates.name: LHX6 as broad direct adult-PH interpreter
demoted_candidates.reason: Only 11 of 1791 Irx3-positive GSE146692 cells co-detected Lhx6 transcript; developmental/rare-cell routes remain open.

demoted_candidates.name: NKX6-3 as broad direct adult-PH interpreter
demoted_candidates.reason: Only 5 of 1791 Irx3-positive GSE146692 cells co-detected Nkx6-3 transcript.

demoted_candidates.name: CXXC4 as a strictly conserved literal human-to-mouse motif mechanism
demoted_candidates.reason: CXXC4 preserves an allele-effect direction in motif scans but does not preserve the same best strand/offset placement between human and mouse; it therefore fails the strict motif-slot portability gate.

cell_of_action.note: The exact 500-bp tile is rare but non-random across official adult hypothalamus subclasses. LHA-AHN-PVH Otp Trh Glut is the most replicate-stable primary candidate state (11/1842 tile-positive; 6/8 samples; pooled enrichment about 3.23x; Mantel-Haenszel OR about 3.64, 95% CI about 1.95-6.79, BH q about 0.00137), with significant cross-sample heterogeneity retained. This prioritizes a cell state but does not establish the native genotype-responsive causal cell.

highest_information_next_test: Exact-allele, sex-stratified, cell-resolved adult posterior-hypothalamus experiment in the prioritized neuronal states measuring Irx3 expression, exact-locus accessibility, local methylation, ARID5B/CUX1/top methylation-reader occupancy, and exact-element-to-Irx3 contact in matched biological material, followed by mediator perturbation/rescue.
